title: Optimal Navigation with Selective Link Reversal
description: You are navigating a directed weighted graph with n nodes. Each node has a unique "switch" that allows you to temporarily reverse one of its incoming edges into an outgoing edge for 2x the original cost. Each switch can be used at most once. Find the minimum total cost to travel from node 0 to node n-1. If it is impossible to reach the destination, return -1.
input_format:
The first line contains an integer n representing the number of nodes.
The second line contains two integers m and c (number of edges and a constant 3).
The next m lines each contain three integers u, v, w representing a directed edge from u to v with weight w.
output_format: Print the minimum cost required to travel from node 0 to node n-1. If unreachable, print -1.
